player_prompt.intro:
U ena le Player {player_id} papaling ya HighSociety (mofuta wa ba bapalami ba babeli).
Tsela ya papadi:  Dikarete tse leshome tsa seriti di rekiswa ka tatelanong.
Ho reka:    Ho reka, kgetha karete ya tjhelete ya 1-11 ka lekunutu la hao, la hlahisa.
            • Teko e phahameng e wina karete ya seriti mme e lahla karete ya tjhelete eo.
            • Teko e tlase e boloka karete ya tjhelete ya eona.
            • Teko e lekana -> dibidiso tsa bobeli di kgutliswa mme karete ya seriti eona e rekiswa hape.
Ho bala:    Kamora mekoa yohle e leshome, eketsa **tjhelete e setseng + diponto tsa seriti**.
            *Bogolo ba lelapa* bo wina (teko e lekana -> kgaolo).

**Mokhoa wa etsahala**  →  reka karete e le nngwe e tshwana le '[7]' kapa '[11]'.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Ke hloka ho hlola ka tsela e lekalekanang le [X] money card.
invalid_move.card_not_held: Ha u sa na karete eo ea chelete.

message.tie: Teko e lekana - dibidiso di kgutliswa. Oka reka hape!
message.auction_result: P0 lemohe {bid0}, P1 lemohe {bid1}. Mopani {winner} hapa seriti {prize} (e fihla {total}).

outcome.draw: Bobeli ba bona, chelete ea bona e feletseng {nw0}  ke ntho e lekanang hantle.
